verdict.rationale: LM Studio lets users attach documents and chat with them via built-in RAG (docs-7, docs-23, docs-24), which can surface AI-generated insights/answers about the user's own data, and the Bionic agent extends this toward more agentic 'insights and suggestions' tasks (docs-15, docs-17, docs-18). However, this is basic document Q&A rather than dedicated analytics/insight generation, and there's no independent evidence of insight quality or of suggestions beyond simple chat responses. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of insight/suggestion quality, richer analytics-style features beyond document RAG, independent corroboration of Bionic's data-insight capability.
